summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K for a second closing of a private placement of Series A units, each comprising one convertible preferred share and a warrant, at $1,000/unit. It issued 662 units for ~$537,000 aggregate gross proceeds under Regulation D Rule 506(c). Preferred shares convert at $0.05/share; warrants have a $0.0625 exercise price and 5-year term. The offering has a $5M base plus $5M overallotment, terminating June 30, 2026. This is a capital-raising, not a special situation.
